title: What Kind of Fool
lyrics_plain:
(Boy and Girl)
There was a time when we were down and out.
There was a place when we were starting over.
We let the bound break, we let the heartache in.
Who's sorry now?
(Girl)
There was a world when we were standing still,
and for a moment, we were separated.
And then you found her, you let the stranger in.
(Both)
Who's sorry now?
(Girl)
Who's sorry now?
What, what kind of fool tears it apart,
leaving me pain and sorrow?
(Boy)
Losing you now, wondering why, where will I be tomorrow.
Forever living what we are to be without each other.
We'll be remembering when.
